name: San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 19, 2021 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of the North County Water Agencies - Water Awareness Poster Contest Winners
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 28, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants List.
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08B Warrants
8C.
Manchester Avenue Utility Agreements with Caltrans for water appurtenance relocation east Interstate 5 (I-5) at Via Poco as part of the North Coast Corrido Phase 1 Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in coordination with General Counsel, to execute the utility agreements between the San Dieguito Water District and Caltrans for the relocation of water improvements and appurtenances east of I-5 at Via Poco and Manchester Avenue.
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08C Caltrans Utility Agreement
8D.
Resolution Delegating Authority to Exercise Discretionary Approval of Designs for Public Works and Public Improvement Projects to the General Manager or Designee. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-14, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Delegating Authority to Exercise Discretionary Approval of Designs for Public Works and Public Improvement Projects to the General Manager or Designee.”
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08D Designate GM to Approve Plans
8E.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2020-21 3rd Quarter Budget Report. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Receive and file this report reflecting a revised project available net position of $13,490,411; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-10, entitled “A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget.”
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08E FY20-21 3rd Quarter Budget Report
8F.
Notice of Completion for San Diego Botanic Gardens Administration and Horticultural Buildings 311 Saxony Lane Public Water Improvements. Contact Person: Senior Engineer Knoll
1) Accept the public water improvements; and 2) Authorize the Interim General Manager to file a Notice of Completion (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08F NOC SDBG 311 Saxony Ln
8G.
Authorize the City Manager to approve grant applications within the purchase authority. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
District Board authorize the City Manager to approve grant applications as long as any required match is within the City Manager’s purchasing authority and if matching funds are required, funds are available in the adopted budget.
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S08G Grant Authorization Authority
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS
Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board.
10A.
Update on the Status of San Dieguito Water District’s 2020 Water Rate Study. Contact Person: Finance Manager Kazungu
1) Review and discuss the initial results of the District’s Water Rate Study; and 2) Provide direction to staff on the presented rate scenarios and advise staff of changes, if any, desired by the board.
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S10A Update on Status of 2020 Water Rate Study
10B.
Public Hearing Regarding San Dieguito Water District's 2020 Urban Water Management Plan, Water Shortage Continency Plan, and Amend the 2015 Urban Water Management Plan to Include Reduction to the Bay-Delta Reliance Appendix. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Knoll
1) Receive public comments regarding San Dieguito Water District's 2020 Urban Water Management Plan, review and discuss the information presented, and advise staff of changes, if any, desired by the board; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-11, entitled "A Resolution of the Board of San Dieguito Water District Adopting the District's 2020 Urban Water Management Plan;" 3) Adopt Ordinance No. 2021-01, entitled "An Ordinance of the San Dieguito Water District Adopting a Water Supply Shortage Response Program as the District's Water Shortage Contingency Plan and Water Conservation Regulations, Adding the Program to the Administrative Code, and Rescinding Ordinance 2015-01;" and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-12, entitled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Amending the Districts 2015 Urban Water Management Plan."
2021-05-19 SDWD Item S10B Adoption of the 2020 UWMP
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT
CERTIFICATION
I, Kathy Hollywood, Board Clerk of the San Dieguito Water District, hereby certify that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City of Encinitas website, www.encinitasca.gov, and on the City Hall outside bulletin board located at 505 South Vulcan Avenue, Encinitas, California, on May 13, 2021 72 hours before this regular meeting.
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
